question: How well do the table's measures predict fasting glucose?
population: NHANES participants aged 18 to 85, one row each, every one with a fasting glucose, from the 9 survey cycles 2001–2002 to 2017–2018.
source: An NHANES export tracked in this repository (turbotab/core/tests/fixtures/nhanes.csv.gz), the table of the app's NHANES glucose journeys. How it was exported from the NHANES files is not recorded with it.
